en: A vintage black-and-white postcard depicting a mosque with a prominent domed roof and a minaret. The mosque is labeled 'Mosquée Saatli-Djami' and is located in 'Salonique' (the French name for Thessaloniki). The surrounding area shows stone walls, a few buildings, and a solitary figure standing on the street. The image has an old postmark and some printed publisher’s information at the bottom.
